recommendation: Keep the audit commit for this reconciliation record and follow up in HL7/kindling by updating PageProcessor.genOperationList/genOperationDetails to render separate Resource and Code columns before rebuilding the FHIR publication output.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core change request asking to add resource name and operation code as left-hand columns in the operations list because the list is sorted by those values while showing only descriptive operation names and invocation URLs.
initial_application: No core-source implementation commit or prior combined-branch audit was found for FHIR-19628. The active source page still delegates the table to the <%operationslist%> include, and the current CI-rendered page still shows the generated two-column title/URL table.
additional_context: source/operationslist.html is active through source/hierarchy.xml and publish.ini, but its operation table is generated by Kindling 1.25.5-SNAPSHOT. Kindling's PageProcessor.genOperationList/genOperationDetails emits only linked title and invocation URL cells. Representative OperationDefinition XML already contains the resource and code values, so the missing columns require generator display support.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No FHIR source file was changed because replacing the generated list with hand-maintained HTML would be fragile and changing the actual generator must happen in HL7/kindling.
